name: csv-data-cleaner
description: Clean and tidy CSV spreadsheet files by removing duplicate rows, fixing column headers and normalising dates. Use when the user wants to clean, deduplicate or tidy a CSV file.
triggers: Remove duplicate rows from my spreadsheet
Tidy the column headers and dates in a CSV
non_triggers: Write a SQL query to join two database tables
Design a logo for my bakery
behaviours: Always ask which columns identify a duplicate before deleting rows
Must keep a backup copy of the original file
